en: Colorized postcard view of a complex of historic buildings and castles sitting high on a steep, rocky, tree‑covered cliff above a river valley at sunset. The left foreground shows a multi‑gabled Renaissance‑style house with red roof (Goethe-Schloss), and further along the ridge are additional palace-like structures with towers and domes. German text, including the place name and Goethe quotations, is printed in red at the top.
